top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori and Ye) are a distinct idea, the magic-wavelength lattice that removes the trap light shift while keeping many atoms, realized at the 1e-18 level and reproduced independently in Sr, Yb and Hg at several laboratories. The credit is clean with two names, the citation is confined to invention and realization without claiming a redefinition of the second, and the achievement is mature and lasting. It is preferable to no award.
